site.derivation_notes: See sources/SITE_DERIVATION.md for the full chain. NO retrievable public filing delineates the project parcel: IA Exhibit C is TEXT-ONLY ('Generator's Moccasin Substation will be located in Stonewall County approximately fourteen (14) miles southeast of Aspermont, Texas') in BOTH the original (PUCT 35077-1924) and First Amended & Restated (35077-2454) SGIA; Exhibit C-1 is a POI electrical one-line (not a land map); an ALTA survey of the property is named as a Generator->TSP deliverable but is not attached to the filing. No Ch.313/JETI reinvestment-zone map exists (structurally ineligible). A Ch.312-type COUNTY reinvestment zone + abatement DOES exist (news-confirmed) but its primary instrument is not retrievable (Stonewall non-reporting; minutes page HTTP 403). Point derivation: text-only estimate 32.9911,-100.0552 (14 mi SE of Aspermont) -> corrected onto the 2026 graded footprint visible in Sentinel-2 -> recorded 33.0210,-100.0217 (footprint centroid ~1.5 km SW). Confidence 'high' is grounded in the CONVERGENCE of location evidence (IA Exhibit C text + SE bearing + Meta PPA 'Stonewall County' + KTXS ~5,000-ac Swenson-Ranch lease narrative all point to this spot), independent of the exact construction-stage read of the footprint. The visible construction footprint IS the best available boundary evidence.

tax_incentives.summary: No state-level value-limitation/incentive filing exists for this project, and none can delineate the parcel as a reinvestment zone. The applicable mechanism is a Ch.312 COUNTY reinvestment zone + abatement, which DOES exist per news reporting, but its primary instrument is not publicly retrievable through the channels available here.

ch313.detail: ch313.py resolve NEGATIVE by INR and by 'Swenson'; JETI arm also negative. Structurally ineligible: the queue entry postdates Ch.313's 2022-12-31 statutory expiry, so no Ch.313 application (which would carry a reinvestment-zone boundary map) exists or can exist. Absence is expected, not merely unfound.

jeti.detail: JETI (Jobs, Energy, Technology & Innovation Act; Tax Code ch.403 subch.T, the post-Ch.313 successor effective 2024) resolve NEGATIVE — no agreement registered for Swenson (this registry check is the hard evidence). JETI is also understood to exclude standalone solar generation from its eligible-project scope (not statute-verified this pass), so a JETI agreement/reinvestment-zone map is not expected in any case.

ch312.detail: ch312.py resolve NEGATIVE, but Stonewall is a NON-REPORTING county — absence from the Comptroller Ch.312 registry proves nothing. Independent evidence shows a Ch.312-type county reinvestment zone + abatement does exist (see county_abatement).

The county's reinvestment-zone designation order is the ONE instrument that would highlight the parcel as a reinvestment zone, but it is a COUNTY record, not state-registered, and not retrievable here (commissioners-court minutes page HTTP 403; no online CAD portal). Sentinel-2 progression brackets construction start to Feb-Apr 2026: undisturbed through 2026-01-31, large bare-soil graded footprint present by 2026-04-26 (imagery/key/s2_2026-01-15.png -> imagery/key/s2_2026-04-15.png).

By 2026-07-20 the footprint is organized into blocks with an established internal access-road grid (imagery/key/s2_2026-07-15.png); civil/earthwork stage, no racking/panels/substation resolvable at 10 m/px.

Identity as solar earthwork (not newly-broken cropland) rests on CONVERGENCE, not pixel proof: previously-undisturbed native brush with intact drainage (2024/2025/Jan-2026) was converted to a geometric graded area precisely at the documented location, timing (KTXS: construction late-2025/early-2026) and ~5,000-ac scale; the W/S perimeter is straight and cuts across former drainage (vs the terrain-following contour rows of the in-frame E-edge cropland); a 5,000-ac conversion of native rangeland to dryland cropland in marginal-rainfall Stonewall Co is implausible.
Footprint sits ~1.5 km SW of the recorded point (33.0210,-100.0217) and is fully captured with the 4.5 km-buffer framing (no clipping).
progression: 2024-07-15 (imagery/key/s2_2024-07-01.png, 0% cloud): undisturbed rangeland/brush; natural drainage; pre-existing farm fields only at frame edges (SW corner, E-edge pivots) — no geometric grid at the site.

The bare-soil(Apr)->green(Jul) shift is graded ground greening under West-TX summer rain (matching the surrounding rangeland's own seasonal greening), not evidence of cultivation.

reasoning_evidence: As of Jul 2026 the site is in earthwork/clearing stage; road grid established, rectangular pads being graded; no racking or electrical work visible at 10 m/px resolution

From earthwork-start (~Q1–Q2 2026) to COD for a 600 MW solar project typically requires 18–24 months (civil, foundations, racking, collection, substation, commissioning); reported 2027-07-06 implies ~14–16 months — aggressive but feasible with strong developer execution
